scope: Read-only live HTTP/source audit and local repository comparison; no deployment or Google account access.
summary: The five public canonical pages are accessible and structurally indexable. Main priorities are the failing www hostname, deploying prepared content, and preserving campaign attribution before PR outreach. Indexation/rankings/Core Web Vitals remain unverified.

findings.title: www hostname returns Cloudflare 522 instead of redirecting

evidence.config: wrangler.jsonc:30 only routes orkidriaseafood.com/*; server/worker.js:156 supports www when reached

findings.impact: Visitors and crawlers using www cannot reach the restaurant; external mentions may link to it.
findings.fix: Confirm proxied www DNS and add www route to the Worker or a Cloudflare redirect rule. Require a single 301 to the apex canonical URL, preserving the requested known page path and marketing parameters. Test HTTPS and HTTP www variants after deployment.

findings.title: Launch content, researched About page and photographic menu are not published

evidence.live_about_title: About Orkid Ria | Seafood Dining in Langkawi
evidence.local_about_title: Our Story & Dining Experience | Orkid Ria Langkawi

findings.impact: Search engines and journalists can only see the older content, not the improved local experience.
findings.fix: Finish factual/photo-rights checks, review and deploy the existing launch branch, then verify production titles, copy, assets and canonical URLs. Request recrawling in Search Console.

findings.scope: LIVE; fixed LOCAL by parent during audit
findings.title: Canonical redirect removes campaign tracking parameters
findings.impact: PR, social and advertising campaign URLs lose attribution before client analytics can record it. No analytics code is installed yet.
findings.fix: Keep known marketing parameters (utm_*, gclid and other chosen click IDs) on the visitor URL and preserve them through host/path redirects. Retain clean rel=canonical. Remove only intentional preview/development parameters. Add regression checks for campaign URLs.
findings.local_fix: Parent reports canonicalRedirect now preserves campaign/repeated query parameters and removes only release/alignment/font/story preview parameters; added 2 regression tests. All 40 tests passed in parent run. Live still strips UTM.

findings.title: Search visibility and conversion baseline is unverified
findings.evidence: No gtag/GTM/custom conversion implementation found in HTML/app.js; this audit has no verified Search Console/GA4/CrUX access. Root agent PSI request returned quota 429.
findings.fix: Verify a Search Console domain property, submit the existing sitemap, inspect the five URLs, and define call, WhatsApp and directions click events in the chosen privacy-appropriate analytics setup. Record mobile field CWV when available; do not substitute file sizes or a mocked test for field data.

findings.title: Public asset responses lack basic security headers
findings.evidence: All five HTML 200 responses lack CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options and Referrer-Policy. API/admin responses have dedicated headers. Public path returns ASSETS.fetch directly at server/worker.js:170.
findings.fix: Add tested public headers without breaking Google Fonts, JSON-LD, images or the Google map iframe. Start with nosniff, a referrer policy and frame protection; test CSP in report-only before enforcement. HSTS should follow verified HTTPS hostname coverage. This is resilience/trust hygiene, not a guaranteed ranking boost.

findings.title: Unknown URLs return correct but blank 404
findings.fix: Configure Worker static assets not_found_handling as 404-page (verify current Cloudflare setting), retaining a real 404 and noindex while showing the branded recovery page.

findings.title: Required Restaurant identity is present; verified geo and current menu details can strengthen completeness
findings.evidence: Consistent Restaurant @id, name, address, phone, hours, image, hasMap, hasMenu and sameAs on all five pages. Local adds Google-documented menu property; live does not yet. No verified geo or priceRange.
findings.fix: Publish local schema with the launch changes. Add exact coordinates only after validating the current Google pin; add priceRange only from an owner-approved current menu. Do not invent ratings, prices or an Offer. Do not add self-serving aggregateRating expecting review stars.

passed_checks: Five sitemap URLs each return HTTP 200 over HTTPS with a unique title, unique description, one H1 and one self-referencing canonical in raw HTML.
robots.txt is HTTP 200, permits public crawling, excludes admin/API and links the sitemap.
sitemap.xml is valid XML with exactly the five HTTPS canonical pages; no redirected, noindexed or missing public pages. Omission of lastmod is acceptable; do not invent dates.
HTTP apex, /menu without slash, /index.html, /about/index.html and workers.dev homepage redirect 301 to the appropriate canonical target.
All page links from the five live documents resolve to the known canonical pages; same-page fragment targets exist. Every main public page is one navigation click from home.

Live JSON-LD parses on every page and shared Restaurant data is internally consistent; WebSite/WebPage, AboutPage/ContactPage and breadcrumbs are present as appropriate. This is source validation, not a completed Google Rich Results Test.
No invented AggregateRating/Review markup; no noindex on canonical pages; core content and metadata do not require JavaScript.

81 resources referenced by current live HTML return HTTP 200 using a browser-style User-Agent, including CSS/JS, image src/srcset and OG image. New local favicon is not live (404) and is not linked by old live HTML.

All local image references exist, all images have alt attributes and explicit dimensions, and responsive WebP srcsets are present. Decorative linked-card images correctly have empty alt alongside accessible link names.
Unauthenticated /admin/reviews returns 401 and no-store with security headers. Build uses explicit public-file allowlist excluding server files, configuration and docs.
limitations: No ranking positions, search volumes, indexed-page counts or field CWV are inferred.

Default Python User-Agent produced 403 responses for assets; browser-style UA rerun returned 200 for every referenced resource. This alone does not establish a verified Googlebot block. Check Search Console live URL inspection and Cloudflare firewall logs.
No browser/mobile interaction checks performed by this specialist; parent owns that verification.
Current business address/hours/phone are consistent across website/schema, but real-world owner verification is separate.
Raw source text word counts are descriptive only. There is no minimum-word-count ranking requirement.
